inspectionMethod: Each assigned page was individually viewed at original resolution through view_image. After final heading punctuation corrections, changed pages 20, 23, 26, 29, 32 and 35 were individually reinspected at original resolution. The other 22 page observations are retained only after exact byte-for-byte comparison with their previously inspected images. All current image hashes and the final Word hash are pinned.
observations: No clipping, overlapping text, missing glyphs, split-off table rows, or footer collisions were found on the assigned pages.
Tables that continue onto a following page repeat their header and preserve full row content.
Long canonical identifiers wrap inside their cells and remain fully visible. Short final fragments are acceptable wrapping rather than clipping.
Section-ending whitespace before a new hierarchy level is intentional; no blank assigned page was observed.
Visible stage-gate prose separates plans, measured evidence, approval, readiness and observed delivery. No project-specific product content was observed.
Restored comma punctuation in Priority, size and dependencies headings remains readable on all six changed pages and produces no overlap or clipping.
